User story: As a local user, I want the app to open an existing or new workspace so I can start work without setup.
Expected behavior based on code: The store lists workspaces, creates one if none exists, hydrates `/api/workspaces/{id}/state`, and the UI shows the active workspace.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live API smoke
Test result: Workspace create/list/state routes returned a usable active workspace on the live server; full Rust workspace tests passed.

User story: As a Chinese-language user, I want Enter to confirm IME candidates without sending, and normal Enter to send chat after composition ends.
Expected behavior based on code: `Chat` mode returns a plain assistant reply without proposal; composer blocks submit during `isComposing` or keyCode 229 and keeps Shift+Enter for new lines.
Initial test approach: Frontend unit test plus live chat route
Initial test command or route: cd web && npm test -- app.test.tsx; POST /api/workspaces/{id}/messages with `你好`
Test result: Live chat returned turnMode=chat and a plain assistant reply; Playwright saw 0 message requests during composition Enter and 1 after normal Enter.

User story: As a user, I want workflow creation/modification prompts to create a pending proposal that I can apply or dismiss before the graph changes.
Expected behavior based on code: Create/modify messages produce a pending proposal with preview graph; apply creates an immutable version; dismiss leaves current graph unchanged.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live API smoke
Initial test command or route: cargo test --workspace; POST messages; POST proposals/{id}/apply; POST proposals/{id}/dismiss
Test result: Initial live Codex workflow proposal failed twice, then retest produced proposal_019f1684448e7c92b60cff27999e979f and apply created a 3-node version.
Errors: 502 unknown field schema_version; 502 edge port type mismatch from video/video to video_output/artifact.
Fix status: Fixed proposal prompt contract in crates/agent/src/prompt_stack.rs and covered it in crates/agent/src/tests.rs.
Notes: Retest created text input, text-to-video, and output nodes with text and artifact edges.

User story: As a user, I want runtime/tool evidence available without polluting the assistant answer.
Expected behavior based on code: `agent_log:*` messages are grouped under an assistant turn and lifecycle noise is not rendered as the main assistant reply.
Initial test approach: Frontend render test and state reducer test
Test result: Vitest render/state tests passed; live agent turns kept lifecycle evidence separate from user-facing assistant text.

User story: As a user, I want to run the current workflow directly from the workbench and see real run state.
Expected behavior based on code: `POST /api/workspaces/{id}/runs` executes the current version through RunService, persists steps/artifacts, and emits WebSocket events scoped by run id.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live API smoke
Test result: Live manual run succeeded; steps text_input, text_to_video, and video_output all completed and produced 3 outputs.

User story: As a user, I want agent-requested runs and sweep runs to wait for explicit confirmation before execution.
Expected behavior based on code: RunRequest and seed sweep create `waiting_confirmation`; approve executes; hold marks the pending run(s) interrupted without provider invocation.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live route smoke
Initial test command or route: cargo test --workspace; POST messages with run request; POST runs/{id}/confirm; POST runs/{id}/hold
Test result: Live run request created waiting_confirmation, hold marked it interrupted, and a second request confirmed to succeeded with outputs.

User story: As a user, I want to interrupt a currently active run without confusing it with confirmation hold.
Expected behavior based on code: `POST /api/runs/{id}/interrupt` targets active manual/sweep runs and returns conflict for non-active runs.
Initial test approach: Automated tests and live conflict smoke
Test result: Full run tests passed; live interrupt against a terminal run returned the expected 409 conflict instead of silently mutating state.
Notes: Default mock runs complete too quickly for a live active-run interrupt window.

User story: As a user, I want to undo the latest applied graph change or restore a previous version from history.
Expected behavior based on code: Undo/restore create a restore-sourced version, keep history auditable, and reject restoring the current version.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live API smoke
Initial test command or route: cargo test --workspace; POST versions/undo; POST versions/{id}/restore
Test result: Live undo created an empty restore version; restoring the applied workflow created a new current version with 3 nodes.

User story: As a user, I want to export the current applied workflow as JSON without leaking runtime-only data.
Expected behavior based on code: `GET /api/versions/{id}/export` returns current graph JSON and rejects non-exportable secret/path/runtime metadata.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live API smoke
Test result: Live export returned schema_version=1 with 3 nodes and 2 edges for the applied workflow.

User story: As a user, I want to choose an output and preview or download it safely.
Expected behavior based on code: Output selection persists for latest run/sweep group; state uses safe `/api/outputs/*` URIs; preview/download hide local storage details.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live API smoke
Test result: Live output preview, safe download URI, and output selection all succeeded after manual run.

Feature / capability: Failed-run diagnosis and minimal fix proposal
User story: As a user, I want failed runs to show an error card and let the agent propose a small fix.
Expected behavior based on code: Failed run state includes failed node/error context; chat shows ErrorCard; debug prompt can produce a fix proposal without changing graph before apply.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live route smoke
Initial test command or route: cargo test --workspace; POST debug message after failed run
Test result: Server/web tests for failed run payload, debug routing, and UI error rendering passed.
Notes: No default live API exposes provider failure injection; this path is covered by automated integration tests.

User story: As a user, I want seed sweep requests to generate multiple pending runs, require confirmation, and select a recommended output.
Expected behavior based on code: Seed sweep messages create grouped waiting-confirmation runs; confirmation executes all; outputs include a selected recommendation.
Initial test approach: Automated tests plus live API smoke
Initial test command or route: cargo test --workspace; POST seed sweep message; POST runs/{id}/confirm
Test result: Live seed sweep request created 4 waiting runs; confirmation executed the sweep and produced 12 outputs with one selected recommendation.

Feature / capability: Primary workbench layout and status affordances
User story: As a user, I want the original ComfyUI Agent workbench layout to remain stable while using these features.
Expected behavior based on code: Top bar, chat pane, canvas, run dock, outputs, history, and confirm modal render from backend state, with provider/connection statuses visible.
Initial test approach: Frontend render test plus live browser screenshot
Initial test command or route: cd web && npm test -- app.test.tsx; Playwright/browser smoke
Test result: Vitest render tests and live Playwright page load passed; composer, current workspace, and backend-driven graph state rendered.
Notes: Browser smoke used http://127.0.0.1:5180/ against the real server on 127.0.0.1:8790.
